sections.text:
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

Leakage oil pump at level 112, works ( 
 Man-Auto) it pumps the leakage oil from the servomotor to the accumulators tank.

The leaking oil 
collected in a tank on the turbine cover and this tank has a float when the 
level of oil in the tank reaches 220mm height the float goes-up, and the mercury 
contact closes and the relay pn-25-T energized and the pump start to work, when 
the level of oil reach 60wm hight the mercury contact opens and the pump stop if 
the level reaches 240mm and the pump did not work a mercury contact closes to 
give alarm.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mohamed Shaaban Al-Behairy, 
 accepted by general director eng. Selem Ahmed Aly, approved by eng. 
 Abd El-kreem Abu Zaid: head 
 sector of High Dam Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC 
quality control general director.

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves

 of leakage oil pump )
